verdict.rationale: v0 provides code-level isolation: work happens on isolated branches with live preview, and preview deployments are built from working branches rather than production. Nothing shows test data is kept apart from production data, though. Environment variables and integrations such as Neon, Supabase and Upstash are shared at the Project level, and there is no documented separate test database or environment-scoped credentials. Missing for 10: documented isolation of data or environment variables between preview and production, a sandbox database or test credentials, and independent hands-on corroboration.
